newsitem.title: USA: TCI Communications to enter partnership.
newsitem.headline: TCI Communications to enter partnership.

text.p: TCI Communications Inc said on Tuesday that it had signed a letter of intent to form a new partnership that will own and operate cable systems in Kentucky, serving about 425,000 customers.

The partnership, between TCIC, affilitates of Blackstone Capital Partners Merchant Banking Fund LP and InterMedia Capital Management VI LP, will form the nation's ninth largest multiple systems operator, the parties said in a statement.
Under the terms of the partnership, called InterMedia Partners VI LP, ICM-VI will be the general partner, and TCIC and Blackstone will each be limited partners, they said.
TCIC will contribute its Kentucky cable system assets and roughly $775 million in debt to the partnership.
IP-VI is currently affiliated with other InterMedia entities serving about 800,000 customers in the Southeast.

"This partnership will provide TCIC's customers in Kentucky with an operator that has a very robust presence in the southeastern region," said TCIC president Leo Hindery Jr in the statement. Additional terms were not disclosed.
Tele-Communications Inc is traded through the TCI Group and the Liberty Media Corp common stocks.
